summary: ```# Marvelous Designer Official Tutorial Video ## Furniture Production p03: Creating Decorative Backrests ### Introduction In this tutorial, we will explore how to create a decorative backrest for a chair model in Marvelous Designer. We will cover the steps needed to design and simulate a realistic backrest, focusing on the technical tools and techniques available in the software. ### Creating the Flower Cover To begin, we will create a flower cover for the back of the chair model. 1. **Designing the Flower Cover** We will make a flower cover for the back of the chicken model. The back of the chicken cannot be used as the chair and floor material. 2. **Organizing the Model** It's important to hide any unused objects. A neat arrangement of the model allows for a better view of the backrest version in the 2D window. ### Positioning the Backrest Model Next, we will use the positioning tool to locate the backrest model accurately. 1. **Adjusting the Corners** Adjust the four corners of the backrest model and then hide it for a cleaner workspace. 2. **Creating Inner Circles** To make a backrest model, we need to create some inner circles first. Press the CTRL key to center the model, then press the SHIFT key to ensure proper alignment. 3. **Copying and Adjusting Inner Circles** Copy and paste the inner circle as needed and place it according to your design preferences. ### Generating the Backrest Model After creating the inner circles, we will proceed to design the backrest model. 1. **Utilizing the Backrest Layer Function** Since we have used the backrest layer function before, the inner circle will automatically generate the backrest line. 2. **Hiding the Outer Panel** To enhance the effect, hide the outer panel and select the inner backrest model to reduce the conflict thickness. 3. **Finalizing the Backrest Model** After pasting it onto the backrest model, we will simulate the pressure of the outer layer, increasing it to 10 to create an inflated cotton effect. The inner circle, sewn together, will remain intact during inflation. ### Adding Fixing Pins Next, we will add fixing pins to stabilize the inner circle position. 1. **Selecting and Fixing Pins** Select all the fixing pins simultaneously and fix them to the virtual model. This will ensure that each pin remains in its original position. 2. **Adjusting Fixing Pins** Sometimes, the fixing pins may be too close to the model, causing them to attach incorrectly. You can manually delete or reposition these pins as necessary. ### Enhancing the Fold Effect To create a more pronounced fold effect, we will adjust certain settings. 1. **Adding Elasticity** For a more obvious fold, select all internal lines to apply elasticity. Reducing the elasticity value slightly will enhance the fold effect. 2. **Adjusting Particle Spacing** Reducing the particle spacing will create more visible folds. 3. **Modifying Foot Angles** Changes in the angle of the foot can make the folds appear sharper or softer. A smaller foot angle results in a softer look, while a higher angle creates a harder appearance. 4. **Elastic Ratio Adjustments** Additionally, reducing the elastic ratio of the circle will further enhance the folding effect. ### Final Adjustments Before concluding, we need to finalize the appearance of the seat. 1. **Hiding Outer Layers** Hide the outer layers of the seat to select the inner model, then activate the model that has been deactivated. 2. **Activating Outer Seats** Display the outer seats and activate them, then turn on the simulation to allow the panels to interact. 3. **Positioning the Inner Model** Hide the side panels and select the inner model. Use the positioning ball to drag the inner model into place, ensuring the outer fabric moves together. 4. **Controlling Movement Speed** Slow down the movement during this process to prevent stretching and ensure proper penetration. ### Displaying Panels To finalize the setup, we will display all panels for a comprehensive view. - Press **Shift + W** multiple times to display all panels effectively. ### Conclusion Following these steps will help you create a decorative backrest in Marvelous Designer, enhancing both the visual appeal and functionality of your furniture model. ```
